scientific_integrity: An analytic anchored-coordinate proof derives the general theorem. Small polytope hull computations, integer finite differences, and independent rejection sampling are verification diagnostics only. Review is not an independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: The exact triple Dirichlet law requires p,q >= 2 with unit complete-bipartite edge inequalities. The joint limit requires positive limiting proportions. It is a statement of intrinsic Euclidean Lebesgue volume, not lattice-point uniformity. Equivalence to a result under alternate probability terminology remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Dirichlet oscillations and universal residual slack in complete-bipartite Lipschitz polytopes
